findings.text: the _NAMED_ZONE guard misses the offset spellings fromisoformat accepts (+00, -05, +000000), so row_moment reads such a stamp as the local wall clock: under TZ=Europe/Paris the -05 input returns 1790654523.0 where base cea6da07 returned 1790661723.0, a silent 7200-second shift for a stamp that names its zone, and no in-repo writer emits those spellings today so the change is invisible to the recorded pin.

the _CACHED_STAMP_ZONE guard refuses +00, -05 and +000000, which base cea6da07 parsed to aware datetimes, so a cache stamp carrying one of those zones now reads as no stamp and returns None instead of the instant it names.
